what_worked: Consistent dark visual theme with clean card layouts and readable typography throughout the deck.
fix_next: Use the assigned 1,000-row dataset; every chart and claim must trace to that data, not unsourced industry statistics.
verdict: Wrong assignment: a generic AI consulting deck with zero engagement with the required dataset.
factual_error_detail: No claims can be checked against the assigned dataset because none reference it. Statistics on slides 4-6, 8-9 are unsourced but not verifiably wrong against external sources either.

evidence.insight: Zero findings from the 1,000-row dataset. Every slide (3-11) presents generic agentic-AI talking points available in any blog post. No original analysis or decision-useful discovery.
evidence.narrative: Coherent consulting arc (evolution → metrics → use cases → risks → roadmap) but entirely disconnected from the assigned data-story task. The sequence would fit any AI strategy pitch.
evidence.framing: No mention of the assigned dataset, its 1,000 rows, missingness, revenue distribution, payment processors, or any analytical question. Audience framed as enterprise strategists (slide 1), not data-story reviewers.
evidence.accuracy: Slides 4-6 and 8-9 present precise percentages (60%, 33%, 62%, 64%, 72%, 82%, etc.) with no citations or dataset grounding. Cannot be verified. No denominators, sample sizes, or sources disclosed.
evidence.visual: Polished dark gradient theme, clean card layouts (slides 3, 7), legible bar chart (slide 5) and pie chart (slide 6). Decorative stock images (slides 8-9) add no analytical value. Timeline (slide 10) is generic.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: 'paradigm shift' (slide 2), 'persistent multi-agent orchestration across core operations' (slide 2), 'deterministic guardrails' (slide 7), boilerplate Q1-Q4 roadmap (slide 10), fake email 'strategy@enterprise-ai.com' (slide 12), decorative AI-generated stock imagery (slides 8-9).

change_reason: Lowered insight from 1→0.5 and framing from 1→0.5 and accuracy from 1→0.5 because the deck contains literally zero engagement with the assigned dataset—every analytical dimension is absent, not merely weak. Visual score kept at 3 for polish. Narrative kept at 1.5 for internal coherence despite total irrelevance.
